resources.string: Icon packs, shapes, colors, and notification dots
LawnchairZ L3 uses accessibility access only for enabled gesture actions, such as locking the device or opening Overview. It does not request or process accessibility events from other apps.
Set LawnchairZ L3 as your default Home app to enable shortcuts, widgets, and profile features
At a Glance can be added to Home with the LawnchairZ L3 widget
To put the device to sleep, enable LawnchairZ L3 as a device admin app. Tap "Open settings", then "Activate this device admin app."
To %1$s, enable the LawnchairZ L3 accessibility service. Tap "Open settings", choose "LawnchairZ L3", then enable the service.
LawnchairZ L3 uses Accessibility\'s performGlobalAction method only for the selected gesture action. The service is not configured to receive or monitor events from other apps.
LawnchairZ L3 pairs two pages to fill the larger display
These settings require a separate privileged Recents build and are unavailable in this standard Home app
